name: ink-cull-not-discard
old: if (ink) { inkSet(P.inkLimb, ink, inkW); gl.bindVertexArray(LIMB.vao); gl.drawElementsInstanced(gl.TRIANGLES, LIMB.count, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0, nCaps); }
new: if (ink) { const fs = FS_INK.replace('if (dot(vN, uEye - vW) > 0.0) discard;', ''); if (fs === FS_INK) throw new Error('no discard to take out'); const K = (render.nd = render.nd || compile(withStyle(VS_INK_LIMB, 1), withStyle(fs, 1), 'ink-limb-culled')); gl.enable(gl.CULL_FACE); gl.cullFace(gl.FRONT); inkSet(K, ink, inkW); gl.bindVertexArray(LIMB.vao); gl.drawElementsInstanced(gl.TRIANGLES, LIMB.count, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0, nCaps); gl.cullFace(gl.BACK); gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE); } /* @negtest */
